DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission

[Project Nos. 2572-141 and 2458-273]


Great Lake Hydro America, LLC; Notice of Revised Procedural 
Schedule for Processing of Relicense Applications

    On September 30, 2024, Great Lakes Hydro America, LLC (GLHA) filed 
applications for new major licenses for the 37.5-megawatt (MW) 
Ripogenus Hydroelectric Project No. 2572 and the 67.9-MW Penobscot 
Mills Hydroelectric Project No. 2458 (herein referred to as the 
Projects). On October 15, 2024, Commission staff issued notices of 
application tendered for filing with the Commission and establishing 
procedural schedule for relicensing the Projects. The notices included 
an anticipated schedule for issuing a Notice of Acceptance/Ready for 
Environmental Analysis by November 2025.
    By this notice, Commission staff is updating the procedural 
schedule, as follows. Further revisions to the schedule may be made as 
appropriate.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
                Milestone                           Target date
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Issue Notice of Acceptance/Ready for       June 10, 2026.
 Environmental Analysis.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Any questions regarding this notice may be directed to Allan 
Creamer at (202) 502-8365, or by email at <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#9afbf6f6fbf4b4f9e8fffbf7ffe8dafcffe8f9b4fdf5ec"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="44252828252a6a2736212529213604222136276a232b32">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>.

(Authority: 18 CFR 2.1)

    Dated: March 12, 2026.
Debbie-Anne A. Reese,
Secretary.
